nudgeRows.title: Tasks list rows: update at once
nudgeRows.description: When a subagent's level changes, narrow the terminal one column and back, so its tasks list row follows in about 0.4 s instead of up to 5 s. Costs two repaints per change and a brief one-column flicker at the right edge; needs the subagentStatusLine setting and python3. Relies on Claude Code internals.
